d:
Prashant kishor ne raj thakre ke bayan par pratikriya dete hue yupi-bihar ke logon ke mudde ko uthaya hai.
Unhonne kaha ki maharashtr men hindi bhashi logon ke sath kuchh galat hota hai to vahan ki bijepi sarkar se saval puchha jaega.
Vahin, PM modi ke bihar daure par PK ne barh, shiksha, rojgar aur chhath speshal trenon ko lekar saval uthae.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
